title: Using Vesicular Stomatitis Virus for Directed Protease Evolution
author: Costacurta, Rauch, et al.
materials: BHK21 (ATCC, cat. no. CCL‐10) or equivalent cells
HEK 293T (293tsA1609neo, ATCC, cat. no. CRL‐3216) or equivalent cells
Dulbecco's and Glasgow's modified Eagle medium (DMEM; GMEM), supplemented
FluoroBrite Dulbecco's modified Eagle medium (DMEM), supplemented
Phosphate‐buffered saline (PBS) (Gibco, cat. no. 10010023, or equivalent)
T25, T75, T175 flasks, 10‐ to 15‐cm dishes, or equivalent vessels
LUNA II cell counter, Neubauer counting chamber, or equivalent device

steps.title: Purify viral RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate VSV‑Mpro genome RNA using the E.Z.N.A. viral RNA kit with carrier RNA, following the kit manual, or alternatively use a semi‑automated system such as easyMAG for high‑throughput purification.

steps.title: Nanopore sequence RNA
steps.instruction: Prepare the purified RNA for Nanopore sequencing according to Support Protocol 1.

steps.title: Plaque‑purify mutants for testing
steps.instruction: Select mutants of interest and perform plaque purification to obtain clonal virus populations for subsequent resistance assays.

steps.title: Produce virus stock via plaque purification
steps.instruction: Using strongly adherent cells, remove culture medium, overlay with plaque agarose, and follow Basic Protocol steps 13‑28 to isolate replication‑competent virus and generate a working stock.
